name: Triumph Thunderbird 6T
engine: 649 cc air-cooled OHV parallel twin, one carb, pre-unit then unit construction
intro: Triumph's touring 650 of the 50s and 60s. One carb, a mild tune and the bathtub rear panel on some years.

K: The gearbox is separate from the engine and has its own oil. Check and change both, and set the primary chain.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
